behaviour: Ham from the hind leg of a pig, salted and air-dried for many months until it is firm and deep red, and sold ready to eat. It is sliced very thin, or chopped small and warmed in fat to give salt and savour. It turns hard and bitter if it is fried for long.

contains.basis: It is the cured leg of a pig.
It is the cured leg of a pig.
Cured meats are often kept with sulphites.
Cured meats are sometimes made with lactose or milk protein.
Some cured meats are made with a cereal filler.
